svg.title: RF vs GB notebook architecture mental map — showing all parts, formulas, happy paths, and errors
svg.desc: Complete architecture diagram of the Random Forest vs Gradient Boosting notebook including 5 parts, key formulas, happy paths in teal, error paths in coral, and a comparison section.
svg.text: RF vs GB notebook — architecture + happy path + errors

g.text: ⚠ T1=T5 identical → ρ=0.99 (too high, less diverse)
⚠ wrong: 1ᵀΣ1 comment says B²×Var²+Cov×Var² (incorrect formula in notebook)
PART C — Random Forest Deep Dive
✓ happy: RF ensemble > avg individual tree
PART D — Gradient Boosting Deep Dive
⚠ α=1 → overfit ⚠ M too small → underfit
⚠ residuals NOT shrinking: underfitting tree / noisy labels / wrong depth / insufficient M / optimization stuck
PART E — RF vs GB Comparison
Both use: Decision trees + Gini splits
Both = ensemble | Both better than 1 tree
✓ RF: quick baseline, noisy data, no tuning
✓ GB: max accuracy, clean data, Kaggle
